title: Polynomial threshold noise modulus
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a real noise parameter $\delta$ with $0\leq\delta\leq\tfrac12$, define the noise modulus to be $\min\{1,3\delta^{2^{-k}}\}$, regarded as a real number in $[0,1]$.
